items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I see Tony Bennett. I say hello. I said, “Tony, I don’t belong here.”

ctx.x: There was another artist they dropped at the same time too, which proved a very funny story.

I will sell that story. There was a world meeting of – Columbia representatives from every part of the world were meeting in New York. They request who they’d like to hear of their artists. It’s usually someone that they’ve done business with for years and is doing well. That’s who would entertain at their gathering. So Goddard Lieberson, then president of Columbia, called me and said, “Could you come in and play for the Columbia meeting.” I said, “I’m no longer – I’ve been dropped from your company.” See, he’d…
